tutorials.title: Find a sample
tutorials.summary: Filter the Samples list by lab ID or status and open a run.

steps.caption: Click Samples in the sidebar: every run is listed, newest first, under the day it ran.
Press Ctrl K, or click Filter lab ID, and type part of a lab ID: the list narrows as you type.
Click a run to open it.
Check the header: the lab ID, its status, the instrument, when it was injected and the method.
Read the chromatogram on Overview; scroll down for the results and the distillation curve.
Use the instrument and status chips, or Not sent to QBench, to list only the runs you need.

tutorials.title: Check a sample in Compare
tutorials.summary: Compare a run with a standard, adjust the graphs, mark a region and edit the conclusion.

steps.caption: Open the Compare tab to check the run against a comparison standard.
Check Compared with: it starts on the best-fit standard; pick another from the list to switch.
Click Adjust to change the thresholds, the shaded ranges and Show up to (min); the graphs redraw.
Click Annotate, drag across the trend chart to mark a region, type a note and click Save.
Under Conclusion, click Edit to change the wording, or Add preset to put in a stock sentence.
Click Save: this run's reports now print your conclusion instead of the generated one.

tutorials.title: Queue reports
tutorials.summary: Collect reports in the report queue, reopen one in Compare, or remove it.

steps.caption: On a final run, click Add to queue at the top right.
Pick the standard, or No comparison (chromatogram only), check the report title and click Add to queue.
Click Report queue at the top of any page; its number is how many reports are waiting.
Click a report's lab ID to open that sample in Compare exactly as the report will show it.
Check the sample in Compare: it opens on the report's standard, with the settings it was queued with.
Click Remove to take a report out of the queue; Clear empties the whole queue.

tutorials.title: Download a report
tutorials.summary: Download one report as a PDF, the whole queue as one ZIP, or the raw CDF.

steps.caption: On a final run, click Export report at the top right.
Check Compared with and the report title, then click Download PDF.
For the chromatogram alone, pick No comparison (chromatogram only) before you download.
In the report queue, click Download all: several reports come as one ZIP file.
For the raw data, open the ⋯ menu (More actions) and click Download CDF.

tutorials.title: Upload to QBench
tutorials.summary: Send the queued reports to QBench and follow each one until it is sent.

steps.caption: Open the report queue and click Upload to QBench.
Check the QBench sign-in, type the password if asked, then click Start upload.
Watch each report's progress; click Skip to leave one out, or Stop to end the upload.
Look for Sent to QBench on each report once the upload has finished.
